title: Symmetric Sum-Free Partitions and Lower Bounds for Schur Numbers
journal: The Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 7 (2000), R32
source_note: The NPS institutional cover labels this publication a work of the US Government without US copyright protection. The original publication is retained for research provenance; author attribution is preserved.
extraction: pdfplumber extraction of page 6, visual inspection of the rendered page, and equality of all integers extracted from the NPS copy page 7.

expansion.rule: Keep the two special values separate. For every other listed x, assign x and 537-x to the same color.

reference_encoder.author: Marijn J. H. Heule
reference_encoder.note: The separately authored C encoder is not vendored. It was downloaded, fully inspected, compiled locally with clang -O2, and its output evaluated under the exact baseline assignment. No SAT search was run.

novelty: Reproduction of the published 2000 construction, not a new lower bound.
